programs.deposit_text: No payment to obtain the Generalitat place allocation (the 'admission'). ESIC's own process: admission tests (motivation letter, business case, English test) then 'place reservation and enrolment' (amount NOT FOUND); ESIC Barcelona guide 6.11.2: reservation is made once definitive admission is known and enrolment follows the university's deadlines. Feb-2026 orientative price for Feb-June: 4,815 EUR.
programs.refund_text: ESIC Barcelona academic guide 2024/25 (sect. 8): 'Los alumnos que por cualquier motivo causen baja, no podrán reclamar en ningún caso la devolución de los importes correspondientes a dicha Matrícula'; no visa-refusal clause in the Barcelona guide. A visa-refusal refund of the reservation exists in the ESIC UNIVERSIDAD (Madrid, private university) admission rules, which do not govern the URV-affiliated Barcelona campus — confirm with ESIC Barcelona in writing.
programs.tuition_text: ESIC Barcelona page (Bachelor's in Marketing, start shown 'September 2027'): 'Tuition: €10,143 - €10,555 per academic year (subject to change)' plus reservation/enrolment fees; no separate non-EU price stated (figure used = upper bound). Feb 2026 Generalitat list: 4,815 EUR orientative for the Feb-June 2026 quadrimester only. Public price decree does not apply (affiliated centres set their own prices, Decree 96/2026 art. 2.1).
programs.graduate_route: Preinscripció (Feb round) with either (a) foreign degree homologated/equated by the Ministry of Universities -> access as 'titulat universitari' with access mark 5 (homologation of a bachelor's degree typically takes many months - not feasible for Feb 2027 unless already granted); or (b) non-EU secondary diploma homologated to Spanish Bachillerato (Generalitat page: homologation mandatory for non-EU systems; for the September round a 'volant d'inscripció condicional'/proof of application is accepted but ranked last - Feb-round rule not published); or (c) direct admission outside preinscripció if the university recognises >=30 ECTS of the foreign studies (allowed for completed foreign degrees only if homologation has NOT been obtained or requested; cannot be simultaneous). URV foreign-studies route: 'validation + admission application' 1-30 April 2026 with enrolment in September (2026-27) — no February entry via this route.
programs.language_requirement: B2 English (CEFR) required: Feb 2026 list note (26) 'Per cursar aquest grau es requereix un nivell B2 d'anglès ... En el cas de no acreditar-lo abans de la matrícula, el centre farà una prova de nivell.' ESIC page: official B2 certificate exempts from ESIC's English test (specific certificates not listed).
programs.official_ruct: Yes (per Canal Universitats: official URV grau at affiliated centre ESIC, 240 ECTS) — RUCT code NOT FOUND

programs.graduate_route: Preinscripció (Feb round) with either (a) foreign degree homologated/equated by the Ministry of Universities -> access as 'titulat universitari' with access mark 5 (homologation of a bachelor's degree typically takes many months - not feasible for Feb 2027 unless already granted); or (b) non-EU secondary diploma homologated to Spanish Bachillerato (Generalitat page: homologation mandatory for non-EU systems; for the September round a 'volant d'inscripció condicional'/proof of application is accepted but ranked last - Feb-round rule not published); or (c) direct admission outside preinscripció if the university recognises >=30 ECTS of the foreign studies (allowed for completed foreign degrees only if homologation has NOT been obtained or requested; cannot be simultaneous). CETT specifics: 30-ECTS route = apply to CETT for 'validated credit transfer' (55 EUR, docs legalised, resolution <=3 weeks); with >=30 ECTS 'apply directly to the center to get the admission (trasllat d'expedient)'; with <30 ECTS -> preinscripció. UB: completed foreign degrees not homologated may use the 30-credit route; homologation and credit recognition cannot be simultaneous. Whether a 30-ECTS admission can START in Feb 2027 is NOT stated (UB framework calendar: each centre's board sets its own trasllat deadline).

programs.graduate_route: Preinscripció (Feb round) with either (a) foreign degree homologated/equated by the Ministry of Universities -> access as 'titulat universitari' with access mark 5 (homologation of a bachelor's degree typically takes many months - not feasible for Feb 2027 unless already granted); or (b) non-EU secondary diploma homologated to Spanish Bachillerato (Generalitat page: homologation mandatory for non-EU systems; for the September round a 'volant d'inscripció condicional'/proof of application is accepted but ranked last - Feb-round rule not published); or (c) direct admission outside preinscripció if the university recognises >=30 ECTS of the foreign studies (allowed for completed foreign degrees only if homologation has NOT been obtained or requested; cannot be simultaneous). UVic entry pathways include 'University graduates' and 'Students with an educational background abroad'. 30-ECTS route for Global Studies (business/economics origin scores 2 affinity points; max 5 places in first resolution); 2026-27 calendar: applications 8 Apr-3 Jul (resolution 14 Jul) and 28 Jul-15 Sep (resolution 21 Sep) — September start only, no Feb window; fee 20 EUR (refunded if you enrol).
programs.language_requirement: Since 2025-26 a B2 English certificate is no longer required for admission, though still recommended (UVic page).
programs.official_ruct: Yes (RUCT 1500050 per UVic page link to RUCT)
programs.data_year: 2025-26 — POSSIBLY OUTDATED (Feb 2026 round is the latest published)
programs.visa_timing_note: NO. Via the Feb pre-enrolment round the earliest possible 'admission' is the place allocation ~6 Feb 2027 (application ~2-4 Feb, enrolment ~9 Feb, 2nd-semester classes start 1-8 Feb 2027 per UB framework calendar). A letter by early December 2026 is IMPOSSIBLE; even the visa application could only start after mid-Feb, i.e. after classes begin.
programs.risks: Private university (higher price than public, but still modest). Vic is ~70 km from Barcelona. 10 Feb places. Letter impossible before Feb 2027. Not CS/business.

notes:
KEY FINDINGS (Catalan Feb pre-enrolment round):
1) The Feb round is a small 'vacant places' call run by the Generalitat (Oficina d'Accés a la Universitat) on accesuniversitat.gencat.cat for the 7 public universities + UVic-UCC. Feb 2026: apply 2-4 Feb, allocation 6 Feb, enrolment 9 Feb (Feb 2025: 3-5 / 7 / 10 Feb). Feb 2027 dates and degree list were NOT yet published on 2026-10-04 (Canal Universitats 'Oferta de places' updated 15.09.2026 still shows only 2026 and 2025 PDFs; the Convocatòries page mentions only June and September). Expect the 2027 list ~late January 2027.
2) Feb 2026 list = 48 offers, almost all at AFFILIATED (private-priced) centres or humanities at UdL; NO computer-science/IT degree of any public university (FIB/UPC, UdL, UdG, URV, UB, UAB, UPF informàtica all absent in 2025 and 2026). The belief that FIB admits new students in February is NOT supported by the 2025/2026 official lists or FIB's 2025-26 regulations.
3) English-taught Feb offers found (2026 list labels them '(docència en anglès)'): URV-ESIC Marketing (16 places), UB-CETT Tourism (10), UAB-EUTDH Tourism (5), UVic-UCC Global Studies (10); plus UB-CETT International Hotel Management (10; has a 100% English option inside one code) and UdL Estudis Anglesos (5; 90% English, 5% French). No French-taught Feb offer found (only UdL English Studies includes 5% French and UVic Global Studies offers French as 'Language B').
4) VISA TIMING: via the Feb round an admission (place allocation) cannot exist before ~6 Feb 2027; enrolment ~9 Feb; 2nd semester starts 1-8 Feb 2027 (UB framework calendar). A letter by early December 2026 is IMPOSSIBLE for every Feb-round programme.
5) Earlier-letter alternative = direct admission with >=30 ECTS recognised (outside preinscripció). Allowed for holders of a COMPLETED foreign degree only if they have NOT obtained/requested homologation (Generalitat; UB; UdL art. 11). Windows found: URV 1-30 Apr 2026 (Sept start); UdL 5-16 Sept & 10-17 Apr; UVic 8 Apr-3 Jul & 28 Jul-15 Sep (2026-27); FIB 10 Jun-10 Jul 2026 (and graduates excluded); UAB 23 Feb-5 Apr 2027 for 2027-28. None provides a February-2027 start. Only CETT (UB) describes a 3-week, 55 EUR 'validated credit transfer' study leading to direct admission (trasllat), with no stated semester restriction — the one lead worth an email (admissio@cett.cat / susanna.vidal@cett.cat) to ask whether a 30-ECTS admission can start in Feb 2027 and whether a letter could be issued in Nov/Dec 2026. Whether a Business Computing degree yields 30 recognised ECTS in Tourism/Hotel Management is uncertain.
6) Graduate quota route: a foreign (non-EU) bachelor's must be HOMOLOGATED/EQUATED by the Ministry of Universities to apply as 'titulat universitari' (access mark 5). Alternative: homologate the non-EU secondary diploma to Spanish Bachillerato (Ministry of Education); for the September round a 'volant d'inscripció condicional' / proof of application is accepted but ranked last — the Feb-round rule is not published. UNEDasiss credential applies to EU/reciprocal systems; PCE (UNEDasiss) can raise the mark.
7) Prices: public universities 2026-27 = 17.69 EUR/credit for all grados (Decree 96/2026; single price, no experimentalitat tiers; 60 ECTS = 1,061.40 EUR + ~150 EUR fees). Social Councils MAY charge non-EU non-residents up to 100% of cost (art. 1.5; a student stay permit is not residence) — UPC (Feb-list note 21) and UPF (Global Studies non-EU 6,800.32 EUR in 2025-26) do so; no UdL non-EU price found. Affiliated centres and UVic set their own prices: CETT Tourism non-EU 8,107 EUR (+314.20 UB fees), CETT IHM 9,671.08 EUR, ESIC 10,143-10,555 EUR, EUTDH 94 EUR/credit (~5,640 EUR), UVic Global Studies 5,757 EUR. Feb-entry orientative prices for Feb-June 2026: ESIC 4,815; CETT Tourism 4,645; CETT IHM 5,483; EUTDH 2,760; UVic GS 3,180 EUR.
8) Payment to secure the place = matrícula (enrolment) after allocation; there is no pre-allocation deposit in the Generalitat process. Visa-refusal refund: explicitly provided only by UdL (credits refunded, admin/support/insurance fees retained; Feb entrants' cancellation deadline 3 Mar 2026). ESIC Barcelona guide: no refund of matrícula on withdrawal (visa clause exists only in ESIC Universidad Madrid rules). CETT, EUTDH, UVic: no visa-refund rule found.
9) Bonus lead (not a Feb start): UPF Global Studies has a non-EU-only early call in February (2025 list code 41066; 600 EUR reservation within 8 days) for a SEPTEMBER start — useful if the applicant could switch to Sept 2027 (English first two years). UPF pages were not directly fetchable (Cloudflare); facts come from search snippets of upf.edu — verify.
